# OmniSkill-template

> Omni template: OmniSkill project scaffold implementing the WyattAu
> OMNI-CORE contract (scripts canonical, Nix devShell, merged CI gate matrix,
> agent-facing AGENTS.md). Derived repos inherit the shared docs gate
> (WyattAu/spec-standards) and the spec/doc skeletons under docs/templates/.

- [README](README.md): what the scaffold creates and how to derive a repo
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): contract inherited by derived repos
- docs/templates: SPEC, TRUTH-TABLE, RESEARCH_LOG, ADR skeletons (SPEC-CORE)
